sentences.text: Bisticeratops is a genus of chasmosaurine ceratopsian dinosaur.
The only known species, B. froeseorum, is represented by a nearly complete skull.
The species name honors Edgar Froese and his son Jerome, members of the band Tangerine Dream.
The holotype specimen NMMNH P-50000 was discovered in 1975 in the Bisti/De-Na-Zin Wilderness of northwestern New Mexico.
The genus name combines "Bisti" (the discovery location) with Greek words for "horn" and "face".
Bisticeratops belongs to the family Ceratopsidae.
Bisticeratops is classified within the subfamily Chasmosaurinae.
The fossils come from the Campanian-age Kirtland Formation.
The animal lived between 83.6 and 72.2 million years ago during the Campanian stage.
